description: This file implements various state handling classes and methods for a lifecycle management system within the WPEFramework plugin. It includes state transition logic such as loading, initializing, pausing, resuming, hibernating, and terminating an application, utilizing external handlers and synchronization primitives.

classes.name: UnloadedState
classes.description: Represents the unloaded state of the application lifecycle, handling the transition from unloaded to other states.

classes.name: LoadingState
classes.description: Represents the loading state, responsible for initializing application context and generating a new application instance ID.

classes.name: InitializingState
classes.description: Handles the initialization process, including starting the runtime manager with launch parameters.

classes.name: PausedState
classes.description: Manages the paused state, handling transitions based on current lifecycle state, including suspending and resuming display rendering.

classes.name: ActiveState
classes.description: Represents the active state where the application is running and render is ready.

classes.name: SuspendedState
classes.description: Handles the suspended state, including waking or suspending the runtime and enabling/disabling display rendering.

classes.name: HibernatedState
classes.description: Represents the hibernated state, managing hibernation and wake-up procedures.

classes.name: TerminatingState
classes.description: Handles application termination, including forceful kill or graceful termination via the runtime manager.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Performs the state-specific handling logic, including invoking external handlers, managing semaphores, and transitioning states.
